/.description: Value Advisory Partners delivers commercial intelligence for resilience, precincts and infrastructure, with 130+ projects across Australia and New Zealand.

/our-team/.description: Meet the Value Advisory Partners team, plus the specialist associates we bring in when a project needs them.

/what-we-do/.description: Our three practice areas: resilience and disaster risk reduction, precincts and development, and infrastructure, amenity and land use.

/what-we-do/resilience/.description: Commercial intelligence for disaster-resilient communities and infrastructure, including the Enabling Resilience Investment framework developed with CSIRO.

/what-we-do/precincts/.description: Place-based land use and precinct assessments using local data, with planning scenarios you can adjust and test in real time.

/what-we-do/infrastructure/.description: Rapid value assessments of infrastructure options, with transparent assumptions that decision makers can validate and share across agencies.

/our-work/.description: Selected commercial intelligence projects across resilience, precincts and infrastructure, from regional adaptation planning to Suburban Rail Loop station assessments.

/publications/.description: Presentations and published reports from the Value Advisory Partners team.

/get-in-touch/.description: Talk to Value Advisory Partners about your next project, with our office in South Melbourne and phone and email contacts.
